sex.Description: Self-reported sex, mapped from the German questionnaire field 'geschlecht'.

Levels.not_specified: Participant was asked and declined to answer ('keine Angabe'). Distinct from n/a, which means the value is missing or was never collected.

age.Description: Age at the demographics assessment. n/a if declined ('keine Angabe') or missing.

bdi_total.Description: Beck Depression Inventory II total score.

fks_mean.Description: Flow-Kurzskala (dispositional, Rheinberg et al. 2003) mean item score.

fam_mean.Description: FAM Freude subscale (Rheinberg et al. 2001, adapted) mean item score.
